pairwise_similarity_matrix.selector_conclusion: the six proposals reduce to exactly TWO distinct signal variables (clusters A and B; cross-cluster |rho| 0.09..0.23). Within cluster A: EXITCAP and OITD are the same book (rho +0.97) and CAPVEL is the opposite book on the same variable. Within cluster B: LIQEPIS and LIQPRO are the identical variable with opposite books (rho +1.00 on values) and TCH is the same family at coarser granularity. With a sprint ceiling of 6 scored cells across at most 2 families, at most ONE proposal per cluster should be selected; treating the six as six independent mechanisms would double-count.
